a.name: Part switch
a.description: A sticky sunk track as a four-way switch (Choose, Checks, Living, Ask), the stage you are in raised; All raises a sheet of rows under stage names.
a.differs_from: A segmented switch of the page's stages in a sunk track, not a row of every section; London's pick is a stepper of stops on a steel band, and the built strips are pill, chip or text rows.

b.name: Question bar
b.description: A slim sticky bar ruled off by thirteen progress ticks: a puppy photo, the current section by number and name, and a key raising the page's thirteen questions.
b.differs_from: One photo-led readout over a tick rule that shows how far down you are, opening the questions word for word; London's pick is a band of named stops and the built strips are chip rows.

c.name: Grouped drop panel
c.description: London's raised card with photo, Jump to a section and Enquire; its panel now drops the sections as ruled icon rows under three stage names.
c.differs_from: Refresh delta, layout: London's two-column grid of eight icon tiles becomes three stage columns of ruled icon rows (one column on phones). Differs from London's pick on all four axes.
